lemmas.primary_translation: wind and twist; act cunningly and flexibly

definitions.text: bevege seg i bukter og svinger
definitions.translation: move in bends and curves (lit. wind oneself)

examples.no: stien snor seg fram mellom steinene
examples.en: the path winds its way between the stones
the snake wound its way through the grass

definitions.text: opptre lurt og fleksibelt, ofte med den hensikt å lure noen
definitions.translation: act cunningly and flexibly, often with the intention of deceiving someone

examples.no: vite å sno seg etter forholdene
examples.en: know how to adapt to the circumstances

examples.no: de snor seg alltid unna dugnaden
examples.en: they always wriggle out of taking part in the communal work

examples.no: prøve å sno seg rundt byråkratiet
examples.en: try to find a way around the bureaucracy
